title: Real Boolean block expectation convergence
statement: Let $n\ge0$, let $0\le\rho\le1$, and let $F$ be a continuous real-valued function on the torus $(\mathbb R/\mathbb Z)^{(\{1,\ldots,n\}\times\{0,1\})\sqcup(\{1,\ldots,n\}\times\{0,1\})}$. For a Boolean vector $x\in\{0,1\}^{nm}$, set $X_m(x)_i=m^{-1/2}\sum_{j=1}^m\sigma(x_{i,j})$, with $\sigma(0)=1$ and $\sigma(1)=-1$, and map each coordinate $u$ to $(u,\sqrt2u)\pmod{\mathbb Z}$. The weighted average of $F$ evaluated on the two mapped block vectors, with weight $2^{-nm}\prod_{i,j}(1+\rho\sigma(x_{i,j})\sigma(y_{i,j}))/2$ for each pair $x,y\in\{0,1\}^{nm}$, converges as $m\to\infty$ to the integral of the same function under the law of $(G,\rho G+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}H)$, where $G,H$ are independent standard Gaussian vectors in $\mathbb R^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a continuous real-valued function on the specified torus
